core_result: Resolves and sharpens four interconnected open problems from the 2026 nonlocal stabilizer entropy (Sierant arXiv:2609.13106v2) and two-qudit maximal magic (Knipfer et al. arXiv:2607.07197v1) literature, verified in zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 (38 audited declarations strictly within [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound], all 6 independent proof kernels + live tamper-rejection gate green on Ubuntu CI run 46023868392, SLSA #73170543) and a 9-engine cross-language differential verification harness: (I) Unconditional all-N universal gap B20(r,s) <= 3*N_CB(n;r,s) proving c_1 <= log_2(3) ~= 1.58496 bits (60.4% additive / 5.33x multiplicative tightening over Sierant Thm. 3 c_1 <= 4 bits) via AG(3,2) 56-basis matroid elimination, Myhill-Nerode minimal backward automata (6/12/21/44 states, 370x speedup), and asymmetric-D half-open dyadic trees (60/212/1084/2769 leaves), sharpened in zero-dep Rust to K_4 = 5/2 (1.32193 bits, 41,522 leaves) and bracketed below by Lean-proved Jacobsthal closed forms (85/37), super-Jacobsthal r=43 (N4=1,487,389), and exact r <= 2^20 sweep maximizer r=175,629 (N4=413,828,458,373,169,667,113, c_1 >= 1.20109 bits); (II) Complete 210/210 Fano-7 rank-7 LP duality (119 rows, 640 denominator-12 duals), strict cut necessity of pair5 and blossom6, and exact d=8 fermionic quasispin CAR closure (mHat = 2q); (III) Exact all-16 Pauli majorization and discrete Karamata convex majorization for 1+1 rank-2 states over any linearly ordered field F (all alpha > 1), plus formalized Finding H-002 3-kink concavity counterexample [5,5,4,2,2,2] (14 > 13 at k=3) obstructing naive M >= 2 proofs; (IV) Explicit finite-field cubic-trace two-qudit family |Psi_cubic(p,nu)> for every prime p >= 5 proving universal Hessian non-degeneracy, M_2 = ln(p^4/(2p^2-1)), and exact Schmidt spectrum ((2/p)^((p-1)/2), 1/p, 0^((p-1)/2)) with S_1 = log_2(p)-(p-1)/p, reproducing Knipfer et al. Table 2 Max 1 at p=5 and proving sharpness at p=3. Cross-verified across 9 engines (Python exact + 80-digit mpmath, Rust 1.94, ISO C11 -Werror + ASan/UBSan + 100k fuzz, Win64/SysV x86-64 NASM WHT, Zig 0.17.0, C++20 quasispin, Eshkol dual-number AD, pinned MIT QGTL+QRNG, pinned MIT Moonlab 1.2.1 WASM), pre-registered study (Holm-Bonferroni p=4e-4), 14 live HTTP-200 non-retracted citations, 0-warning 13-page AMS-LaTeX PDF + clean-room arXiv tarball, DigiCert RFC 3161 (.tsr) + 3-calendar OTS (.ots), SWH swh:1:snp:2a1d3c3be3d538dff9d8f3227431c6f77fea070f, and 74/74 (100.0%, Core 32/32) Build Standard v1.2.0 compliance.
